text: かつ　ときは　かつんだけど　まける　ときは　まけちゃうんだな

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short, casual form of てしまう, which says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. まけちゃう = 'I end up losing'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: A verb right before とき gives the time when something happens. かつ　ときは = 'when I win'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb gives the feel of explaining how things are; けど then adds 'but'. かつんだけど = 'I do win, but'.
